Supreme Court Questions 10x Price Markup on Cancer Medicine

The Supreme Court has questioned the significant price difference in cancer medicine, noting that a drug costing ₹2700 to the retailer is being sold to patients for ₹27000. The court observed that patients are being "extorted" due to this 10-fold markup.
